en: Tax deadlines, returns, notices and penalties for every client in one file
sales tax or VAT, income tax, payroll, withholding and annual accounts for all clients over 12 months, with days to go and a status
Filing tracker from first request to accepted
each return moves through seven stages with hours, fee and preparer, so you see which returns are stuck before the deadline
tax charged and tax on purchases give the tax to pay or refund, the due date and a check that the detail lines add up to the return
Income tax estimate by bands or company rate
profit, add-backs and reliefs give the taxable profit and the tax for each business type, the instalments paid, the balance and the monthly amount to set aside
Instalments and prepayments with days late
every instalment shows the amount left, days late and a status, so a missed prepayment is seen before interest builds up
the gross payment and rate give the tax withheld, the net paid and the date to remit, with overdue remittances flagged
flat penalty, percentage penalty and interest are added up and the cause says whether the client or the practice bears the cost
Tax notices and audits with reply dates
each letter from an authority has a reply date, days left and a status, and each audit shows hours spent and the tax at risk
Deductions review with a business share
each expense gets a business share and a decision; the deductible part, the part disallowed and the tax saved come out using your own meal and rate settings
losses show the balance left, the last year to use them and their tax value; assets show claims so far and the tax written-down value
company tax, tax on pay and take-home are worked out for each owner and compared with the best split
Return documents chased by days waiting
every document asked for is timed from the request, so a client holding up a return is marked chase now

One row for each client with country, business type, registration and turnover; open returns, overdue deadlines, next due date, tax paid and penalties fill in from other sheets.
Registered for sales tax or VAT
Every return and payment date for every client over 12 months. Type the date filed and the status shows filed, filed late, overdue or due soon.
Filing tracker: where every return stands
One row for each return being prepared: stage from not started to accepted, hours, fee and who prepares it. The status shows whether it is filed on time, late, overdue or due soon.
Sales tax or VAT returns by period
One row for each client return: sales, tax charged and tax paid on purchases. The tax to pay or refund, the due date and the status fill in, and the detail lines are checked against the totals.
Sales tax or VAT lines on sales and purchases
The invoice and bill lines behind a return: type the net amount and the tax rate and the tax, the gross amount and the month come out. Use it to prove the totals on the return.
Income tax estimate for every client
One row for each client and tax year: profit, add-backs and reliefs give the taxable profit and the tax by bands for individuals or at the company rate. The instalments paid give the balance left.
Each instalment of each client: due date, amount, paid and when. Days late, the amount left and the status (paid, part paid, overdue or upcoming) fill in by themselves.
Withholding tax on payments to others
Each payment from a client to a supplier, landlord or lender that needs tax withheld: type the gross amount and the rate; the tax withheld, the net paid, the remit date and the status come out.
Every penalty or interest charge with its cause. Type the unpaid tax and the days late; the flat penalty, the percentage penalty, the interest and the total come out, and who bears the cost.
Each request for more time: the original date, when you asked, the new date and the answer. It shows the days gained and whether you asked before the deadline.
Each letter from an authority: type, amount, the reply date and when you replied. The days left and the status (answered, waiting, due soon or overdue) fill in so no notice is missed.
Each payment to an authority for a client with the kind of tax, method and bank reference. It feeds the tax paid on every client and the cash plan by month.
Each expense you check before a return: type the amount, business share and decision; the deductible part, the part disallowed and the tax saved come out.
Each asset with cost, purchase date and the yearly allowance rate. The years held, the allowance claimed so far, the tax written-down value and this year's claim come out.
Each tax loss with the year it arose and how much has been used. The balance left, the last year it can be used and its tax value fill in, so no loss expires unnoticed.
Salary and dividend planner for company owners
Each company owner: the profit before pay, the salary and the dividend planned. It works out the company tax, the tax on each, the take-home pay and whether another split would leave more.
Annual returns, ownership updates, accounts filings and licence renewals due at business registries. Type the date filed and the status shows on time, late, overdue or due soon.
Each document you ask a client for before a return: when asked and when received. The days waiting and the status (received, waiting or chase now) show which clients are holding up the work.
Audit and information requests from authorities
Each audit or information request: scope, reply date, hours spent and the outcome. It shows the status, the days open and the extra tax at risk from any adjustment.

Open Start and type your practice name and your rates in the yellow cells: sales tax or VAT rate and days to file, penalty and interest rates, income tax bands, company rate, loss years and warning days.

Tax rates and penalty rules differ by country. Every rate in this workbook is your own setting, so check them against the rules where each client is taxed: the workbook tracks your work and is not tax or legal advice.

Fill Client Tax Profiles: one row for each client with country, business type, registration, turnover and year-end month. Open returns, overdue deadlines, tax paid and penalties fill in by themselves.
Use Deadline Calendar as your master list: one row for each return or payment date. Type the date you filed and the status changes to filed, filed late, overdue or due soon.
Track the work on Filing Tracker: move each return through the stages from not started to accepted, and fill in hours and fee to see the fee per hour.
Enter each sales tax or VAT return on Sales Tax or VAT Returns, and the invoice and bill lines on Tax Lines. The sheet checks that the lines match the tax charged on the return.

On Income Tax Estimates enter profit, add-backs and reliefs for each client. The tax follows your bands or company rate, and the instalments paid on Tax Instalments give the balance and the monthly set-aside.
Record every payment to an authority on Tax Payments and every payment that needs tax withheld on Withholding Tax. The remit date and status come out by themselves.
Log every penalty with its cause on Penalties and Interest, so you see how much the practice paid itself, and every request for more time on Extension Requests.
Log each letter from an authority on Tax Notices and each audit on Audit Requests with the reply date. Overdue replies show in red on the dashboard.
Review expenses on Deductions Review, assets on Tax Depreciation, losses on Loss Carry-Forward and owner pay on Pay and Dividend Planner before the year ends.
Ask clients for records on Return Documents. Anything waiting more than twice your warning days shows as chase now.
Use the 14 calculators to check a return, estimate income tax by bands, plan instalments, price a penalty, plan a loss, compare salary and dividend, and set aside tax each month.

Print client tax cards, return sheets, notice files and certificates from the printable sheets, choose letters and checklists by the number in the yellow cell, and tap a message link to open WhatsApp with the text ready.
Read Tax Dashboard and Charts every week: deadlines, overdue returns, tax still to pay, penalties, open notices and documents to chase at a glance.
